title: listing_pending_review
description: A listing entered the pending status and is waiting on a moderator before it can publish. Not yet dispatched by Pro's Outgoing_Webhooks (no listing_pending_review entry in get_event_source_map()) - this describes the flat payload the declared Payload::listing() builder (wb_listora_automation_payload_listing(), the wb_listora_get_listing_cards() card shape) would produce, flattened at the top level with no nested envelope.
